steps.name: dry
argv:
import hashlib, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
CLONE = r"C:\banyan-farm\banyan-city"
sys.path.insert(0, CLONE + r"\pipeline")
fails = []
def check(ok, label):
    print(("  ok   " if ok else "  FAIL ") + label, flush=True)
    if not ok:
        fails.append(label)
check(os.environ.get("STRENGTH") == "0.55",
      "per-step env arrives (STRENGTH=%r)" % os.environ.get("STRENGTH"))
init = os.environ.get("INIT", "")
INIT_SHA = "874d36f566cf251753a6835144eed76fbbef558df65a30f3efa913c75d942454"
if init and os.path.isfile(init):
    h = hashlib.sha256(open(init, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    print("  init sha256 %s" % h, flush=True)
    check(h == INIT_SHA, "init is the s2 frame he called really good (%s)" % INIT_SHA[:16])
else:
    check(False, "init file exists at %s" % init)
SC = CLONE + r"\pipeline\runpod_render.py"
HARNESS_SHA = "dd834f57f987a090fcb6cebd8cbd5ff5fdcf306125bbef43739f71f1517ebd9c"
hh = hashlib.sha256(open(SC, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
print("  harness sha256 %s" % hh, flush=True)
check(hh == HARNESS_SHA, "runpod_render.py is the copy the approved arm ran")
import runpod_render as rr
from generate_shots import parse_shots
shots = Path(CLONE) / "genomes/sapling/nodes/002b-first-citizen/shots.md"
print("  shots.md sha256 %s" % hashlib.sha256(shots.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
raw = [s for s in parse_shots(shots.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if s["num"] == 1]
check(len(raw) == 1, "exactly one beat 1 in shots.md")
s = raw[0]
FENCE = ("A tiny 40cm seedling standing in short grass, its sturdy curved stem "
         "no taller than the grass around it, two oversized cotyledon leaves, "
         "one small round green fruit hanging from the stem, whole plant in "
         "frame, wide shot, peach and gold sunrise sky, no girl, no boy, no "
         "child, no person, no chibi, no mascot, no creature, no face, no "
         "branches, no night sky, cinematic lighting, detailed, newest, "
         "masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic No photorealism, no 3D "
         "render look. 9:16 vertical, no text.")
check(s["prompt"] == FENCE, "beat-01 fence is byte-for-byte the one the approved arm sent")
check(s["slug"] == "cold-open", "slug is cold-open (output filenames depend on it)")
pos, dropped = rr.compress(s["prompt"])
neg = rr.beat_negative(rr.NEG, s["prompt"])
print("\n  POS: %s\n\n  NEG: %s\n" % (pos, neg), flush=True)
check(not dropped, "nothing dropped from the positive for budget (%r)" % (dropped,))
check("one small round green fruit hanging from the stem" in pos, "FIG term in the positive")
check("two oversized cotyledon leaves" in pos, "LEAF term in the positive")
check("cinematic lighting, detailed, newest, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic"
      in pos, "detailed-cinematic-anime tail in the positive")
seeds = [rr.SEED + 1 + k * 1000 for k in range(4)]
print("  seeds: %s" % seeds, flush=True)
check(seeds[:2] == [20260720, 20261720], "s0/s1 are the two seeds he approved")
print("\nDRY: %d check(s) failed" % len(fails), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1 if fails else 0)

steps.name: render
argv:
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
CLONE = r"C:\banyan-farm\banyan-city"
SC    = CLONE + r"\pipeline\runpod_render.py"
RAW   = os.path.join(CLONE, "runpod-out")
OUT   = r"C:\banyan-farm\out-b01-final"
sys.path.insert(0, CLONE + r"\pipeline")
strength = os.environ["STRENGTH"]
init     = os.environ["INIT"]
init_sha = hashlib.sha256(open(init, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
print("strength %s init %s sha256 %s" % (strength, init, init_sha), flush=True)
rc = subprocess.call([sys.executable, SC])
if rc:
    sys.exit(rc)
import runpod_render as rr
from generate_shots import parse_shots
shots = Path(CLONE) / "genomes/sapling/nodes/002b-first-citizen/shots.md"
s = [x for x in parse_shots(shots.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if x["num"] == 1][0]
pos, _ = rr.compress(s["prompt"])
neg = rr.beat_negative(rr.NEG, s["prompt"])
shots_sha = hashlib.sha256(shots.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
harness_sha = hashlib.sha256(open(SC, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
try:
    commit = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", CLONE, "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
                            capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or "unknown"
except OSError:
    commit = "unknown"
APPROVED = {0: "61f311b8b971002b39043d73e4a9d319655b00db7e866a636a9e09c4c0fe9a90",
            1: "8caad7862dc62351e654f97b553f7de3fa28b602f7372b1d0a16c25f76ce8a99"}
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
moved = 0
for k in range(4):
    src = os.path.join(RAW, "01-%s-s%d.png" % (s["slug"], k))
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        print("   !! missing %s" % src, flush=True)
        continue
    dst = os.path.join(OUT, "b01-final-055-s%d.png" % k)
    shutil.move(src, dst)
    moved += 1
    sha = hashlib.sha256(open(dst, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    seed = rr.SEED + 1 + k * 1000
    repro = ""
    if k in APPROVED:
        same = sha == APPROVED[k]
        repro = "identical" if same else "DIFFERENT"
        print("   reproduction check s%d vs approved i55: %s" % (k, repro), flush=True)
        if not same:
            print("   !! s%d does not reproduce the approved frame. The recipe is "
                  "pinned, so something underneath moved — read the metas before "
                  "showing these." % k, flush=True)
    with open(dst + ".meta.yaml", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join([
            "task: ep2-b01-final-055-0812",
            "node: 002b-first-citizen",
            "beat: 1",
            "strength: " + strength,
            "recipe_status: >-",
            "  the arm the founder approved on 2026-08-12 (\"strength 0.55 looks",
            "  good\"), scaled from 2 seeds to 4. No other parameter moved.",
            "model: " + rr.BASE,
            "dtype: bfloat16",
            "pipeline: StableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline",
            "harness: pipeline/runpod_render.py",
            "harness_sha256: " + harness_sha,
            "harness_modified_for_this_round: false",
            "init_image: " + json.dumps(init),
            "init_sha256: " + init_sha,
            "init_provenance: >-",
            "  ep2-b01-t2i-fig-0811 seed s2, the frame he called \"really good\" at",
            "  ~23:45 on 2026-08-11; also on farm-results-rtx5090 at",
            "  farm-out/ep2-b01-t2i-fig/01-cold-open-wave1-s2.png.",
            "size: 832x1216",
            "steps: 40",
            "guidance: 7.5",
            "seed: %d" % seed,
            "seed_rule: SEED(%d) + BEAT(1) + k*1000" % rr.SEED,
            "reproduces_approved_frame: " + (json.dumps(repro) if repro else "n/a — new seed"),
            "prompt_source: genomes/sapling/nodes/002b-first-citizen/shots.md beat 1",
            "prompt_source_sha256: " + shots_sha,
            "positive: " + json.dumps(pos),
            "negative: " + json.dumps(neg),
            "fig_term_note: >-",
            "  the fig words are in the positive and stayed there; the object they",
            "  actually draw read as a veined leaf in the probe",
            "  (ep2-b01-styleprobe-0812-observed). Open question for R4, not fixed here.",
            "repo_commit: " + commit,
            "cost_usd: 0",
            "sha256: " + sha,
            "provisional: >-",
            "  Not canon, not published, not assembled. Candidate frames at an",
            "  approved recipe; the pick is R4's.",
            "",
        ]))
    print("   %s  %s  seed=%d" % (os.path.basename(dst), sha[:16], seed), flush=True)
shutil.rmtree(RAW, ignore_errors=True)
print("wrote %d frame(s)" % moved, flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if moved == 4 else 1)

steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b01-final-055-0812"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/out-b01-final/b01-final-055-s*.*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
    print("   ", os.path.basename(f), h[:16])
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b01-final-055-0812.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) == 8 else 1)
